user.title: Add KDE Connect device
user.description:
Choose a one-time scan of your local network (no background broadcasting), or enter the device IP/hostname manually. Scan shows found devices (name, ID, IP) so you can pick deliberately.

{found}

pair.title: Pair with device
pair.description: Submit to send a pairing request to this device, then accept it in KDE Connect on the device when prompted. Home Assistant will wait for confirmation.

abort.already_configured: This KDE Connect device is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device over UDP 1716 or complete the TLS handshake. Check that KDE Connect is running and discoverable on the network.
abort.pairing_timeout: The device did not confirm pairing within the timeout.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device.
error.invalid_port: Invalid TCP port: must be between 1716 and 1764.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing was not confirmed by the device yet. Approve it in KDE Connect and try again.
error.no_devices_found: No KDE Connect devices were found on the local network during the scan.

init.title: KDE Connect options
init.description: Default SMS recipients (one per line, phone numbers). Local run-commands: one per line as 'key=command'; enable execution to let the device trigger them on this Home Assistant host. Pairing requests sent from the device are accepted automatically only when enabled.

data.allow_remote_commands: Allow the device to run local commands
data.auto_accept_pairing: Automatically accept pairing requests from the device

pairing_pending.title: KDE Connect pairing is not confirmed
pairing_pending.description: Home Assistant is connected to {device_name}, but the device has not confirmed pairing. Call the kde_connect.pair service (or reconfigure the entry) and accept the pairing request in KDE Connect on the device.

pairing_request.title: KDE Connect pairing request
pairing_request.description: {device_name} wants to pair with Home Assistant. Call the kde_connect.accept_pair service to approve it.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Displays a notification on the paired KDE Connect device.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Sends an SMS through the paired KDE Connect device.

phone_number.name: Phone number
phone_number.description: Recipient number. Uses configured default recipients when omitted.

find_my_phone.name: Find my phone
find_my_phone.description: Triggers the device's find-my-phone plugin (ring and vibrate).

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Play the configured ringtone on the device.

request_notifications.name: Request notifications
request_notifications.description: Asks the device to push its current notifications to Home Assistant.

cancel_notification.name: Cancel notification
cancel_notification.description: Removes an active notification on the device.

notification_id.name: Notification id
notification_id.description: Id of the notification to cancel.

notification_reply.name: Reply to notification
notification_reply.description: Replies to a notification on the device that supports replies.

reply_id.name: Reply id
reply_id.description: replyId of the notification being replied to.

pair.name: Pair device
pair.description: Sends a pairing request to the device and waits for it to be accepted in KDE Connect.

unpair.name: Unpair device
unpair.description: Tears down the pairing with the device.

accept_pair.name: Accept pairing request
accept_pair.description: Approves a pairing request the device sent to Home Assistant.

ping.name: Send ping
ping.description: Sends a ping to the device (one-way; the device shows a notification).
